asset: S03a foreground grandmother anatomical right hand supporting intact thin watermelon sector
coordinate_convention: Image coordinates: origin upper-left, x right, y down; points refer to uncropped original canvas. Alpha is straight PNG alpha. Preserve full canvas or subtract crop origin from all anchors.

wrist_seam_center.kind: exact midpoint of recorded compositing seam, stable placement anchor

melon_far_tip.kind: manual visual estimate, tolerance about 3 px

palm_rind_load_contact.kind: manual visual estimate of supporting contact, tolerance about 8 px

thumb_rind_contact.kind: manual visual estimate, tolerance about 8 px

forearm_axis_proxy.kind: manual centerline proxy, not anatomical landmark

placement_contract.transform: Uniform scale plus translation preferred; no geometric rotation needed to fake a view. Blur and push-in belong to scene code.
placement_contract.anchor_formula: tx = target_wrist_x - scale*866.5; ty = target_wrist_y - scale*609.0; transform every other anchor identically.
placement_contract.crop_rules: Do not use alpha bbox as a new origin without subtracting its left/top from every anchor. PNG extends off canvas at right/bottom intentionally.
placement_contract.shot_gate: Check actual final shot: foreground overlaps only intended right collar/chest, does not touch chin/lips/cheek; inspect final blur and temporal movement. Static approval does not approve scene placement.

approved_direction_scene_guide_only.note: These are construction guide targets, not recovered camera geometry. Current source anchors cannot all hit these targets under one exact uniform transform. Prioritize actual silhouette and chin clearance; no scene integration has been approved here.

registration.why: Tool output enlarged/moved the group despite fixed-layout instruction. Registration restores approved local geometry before the bounded mask composite. It does not invent a new view.

notes: No bracelet, no bite, one thin sector and five seeds. Right thumb at image upper right; four curled supporting fingers are intentionally visible.
The final approved PNG is byte-for-byte copied, not sanitized or regenerated. Use straight-alpha compositing; RGB under alpha zero is not visible image content.

edge_contract.runtime_blur: Apply only at scene integration; do not resave approved sharp PNG.
edge_contract.alpha_semantics: Straight alpha. Full canvas intentional; right and bottom forearm exit cropped at canvas boundaries.
edge_contract.outside_repair_mask: Byte-exact approved base RGBA; transparent pixel RGB may be nonzero and must be multiplied by alpha for display.
